testCase:
H-07: A menu that stays open after navigation
Goal: Choose the Pro plan from the Pricing page.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/h-07/
STEP 2: Hover over "Products"
STEP 3: Click "Pricing"
STEP 4: Click "Choose Pro"
STEP 5: Verify "Pro plan selected" is visible

plan.title: H-07: Choose Pro through persistent menu

steps.note: Verify the Pro plan selection succeeded.

reasoning: This test checks that the Pro plan can be selected from Pricing after opening the Products menu. The plan follows the specified navigation and verifies the final selection message.
